items.title: Backpackers say visa changes make regional work less attractive
items.summary: Backpackers report that a new ballot system and reduced visa numbers for second and third-year stays are discouraging them from taking regional jobs.
items.article_html:
Sweeping wine residue from a tank in the heat of the day is no-one's idea of a dream job.

The Irish backpacker is willing to get her hands dirty in exchange for a visa.
items.description: And not a single word or question in the article about paying Australians more to do the job.
top_comments: It came up when the Australian fruit picker farmers got caught out barely paying backpackers for the work.
Agri/horticulture awards are just a joke.
